description: The Goodman High Throughput Spectrograph (Goodman HTS) on the 4.1-meter SOAR Telescope provides optical imaging and spectroscopy using Bessell, SDSS, Stromgren, and custom narrow-band filters.
facility_description: The Southern Astrophysical Research (SOAR) 4.1-meter Telescope is an optical/near-infrared telescope located on Cerro Pachón, Chile, operated by NSF NOIRLab and CTIO.
notes: Goodman uses filter wheels in the collimated beam. PhotSystem is given only where the filter name itself names the system (Bessell, SDSS, Stromgren).
